stem: \[0.4x + 0.3y = 5\] \[0.2x - 0.1y = 0.5\] If \((x, y)\) is the solution to the system of equations above, what is the value of \(y\)?
solution: Multiply both equations by 10: \(4x + 3y = 50\) and \(2x - y = 5\).
verify:
x, y = symbols('x y')
sol = solve([Rational(4, 10)*x + Rational(3, 10)*y - 5, Rational(2, 10)*x - Rational(1, 10)*y - Rational(1, 2)], [x, y])
assert sol == {x: Rational(13, 2), y: 8}
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [sol[y]]
